loop: Player avoids enemy bullets and survives as long as possible against random chaser and shooter enemies.

requirements.verification: Player moves freely in 2D top-down space.

requirements.source: evade enemy bullets and survive for as long as player can
requirements.meaning: Endless survival by dodging enemy projectiles
Player takes damage from bullets and dies after 3 hits

requirements.source: each enemy spawn at random places
requirements.meaning: Enemies spawn at random positions on the map

requirements.source: enemies have different types (enemies can chase player, shoot bullets )
requirements.meaning: Two distinct enemy behaviors: chaser and shooter
requirements.verification: Some enemies chase the player while others shoot.

requirements.source: the enemy spawned will have its type(chaser , or bullet shooting ) at random
requirements.meaning: Randomized selection of enemy type upon spawn
requirements.verification: Spawned enemies randomly become chasers or shooters.

requirements.source: the enemy type can shoot will shoot 5 bullets after 1 second each and then die
requirements.meaning: Shooter enemy fires 5 bullets at 1-second intervals and then self-destructs
requirements.verification: Shooter enemy fires 5 shots sequentially every second and self-destructs.
